full_prompt_en: A square watercolor-like figure study shows a child sitting cross-legged and writing on a sheet of paper, set against a warm, nearly blank cream background. The surrounding space is left open, with only a faint horizontal suggestion of floor beneath the child. Tousled light-brown hair forms a soft rounded mass at the upper center, and the child bends the head down so the eyes follow the page. A loose blue outer garment wraps around the shoulders and falls in broken folds toward the lower right. Beneath it, an off-white tunic and billowy cream trousers create a quiet contrast with the blue. The knees rise on either side of the paper, and small dark shoes meet near the lower center of the frame. One hand steadies the sheet across the lap while the other holds a thin writing tool angled down toward it. The face is treated delicately, with a small nose, soft cheek shadow, and concentration conveyed mainly by the lowered head. Fine brown drawing lines clarify fingers, cloth folds, and the edge of the page, while translucent washes gather darker color along the garment's seams. Light comes broadly from the upper left, making the hair and pale fabric glow and leaving only light contact shadow near the feet. The open paper ground absorbs the outer contours in places, giving the form a gentle unfinished edge. Muted blue, beige, warm brown, and cream stay within a narrow, airy range. The overall composition makes the small act of writing the calm center of a spacious and tender study.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、近似水彩的人物习作描绘一名孩子盘腿坐着，在一张纸上书写，背景是温暖而几乎空白的奶油色。周围空间保持敞开，只在孩子下方有一道隐约的水平地面暗示。蓬松浅棕发在上方中央形成柔软圆形，孩子低下头，让目光追随纸面。宽松蓝色外衣包住双肩，沿断续衣褶垂向右下。里面的灰白上衣与蓬松奶油色裤子同蓝色形成安静对比。双膝在纸张两侧抬起，小小深色鞋子在画面下方中央附近相接。一只手稳住腿上的纸，另一只手持细长书写工具向纸面斜下。面部处理细腻，小鼻子、柔和脸颊阴影，以及主要由低头姿势表达的专注感清晰可见。细棕色线条理清手指、衣褶和纸边，透明色洗则沿衣缝积起更深的颜色。光从左上方宽泛落下，让头发和浅色布料发亮，只在脚边留下淡淡接触阴影。纸张底色在若干处吞入外轮廓，使形体边缘带有温柔的未完成感。柔蓝、米色、暖棕与奶油色保持在狭窄通透的色域内。整体构图让书写这一细小动作成为宽敞而温柔的习作中心。
style_prompt_en: The image has a delicate watercolor-and-drawing finish on warm paper, with transparent color washes held together by fine brown lines. Muted blue, cream, beige, and soft earth tones remain light in value, with slightly stronger pigment gathering only at folds and contact points. Contours are precise around the focal details but thin out or disappear in the open margins, letting the paper itself complete some forms. Short drawn marks describe small structural changes; broad, uneven washes make larger planes breathe. Light is diffuse and pale, with minimal shadow, so depth comes from overlapping shapes and controlled changes in pigment density. A compact central grouping sits within generous unmarked space, producing a slow, intimate visual rhythm. The overall effect is gentle, observant, and quietly unfinished.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现暖色纸上的细腻水彩与素描质感，透明色洗由细棕线条连结。柔蓝、奶油色、米色和轻淡土色保持较亮明度，稍浓的颜料只聚在褶皱和接触点。焦点细节周围的轮廓精确，向敞开的边缘则变细或消失，让纸本身补全部分形体。短促画线描述细小结构变化，宽而不均匀的色洗让较大平面得以呼吸。光线漫射而浅淡，阴影极少，因此纵深来自形体重叠和受控的颜料浓淡变化。紧凑的中央聚合体置于宽裕的无标记空间中，产生缓慢亲密的视觉节奏。整体效果温柔、善于观察，且安静地保留未完成感。
theme_en: A child seated cross-legged while writing on a sheet of paper
theme_zh: 盘腿坐着在纸上书写的孩子
name: John Frederick Lewis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
